{{Top|canon=Great Galactic Seal}}
[[File:Galactic_Great_Seal.png|thumb|300px]]

The '''Galactic Great Seal''' was the term given to the emblem of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. In some cases, the Great Seal was surrounded by the individual seals of the [[Thousand Worlds]]. The most prominent Great Seal was found on the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] owned a [[Ceremonial staff (Finis Valorum)|ceremonial staff]] that was capped with the Galactic Great Seal.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|pack=Chancellor Valorum|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/episodeIvalorum.asp}}</ref>
The [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] stole the seal from the Chancellor's Podium while renovations were being completed, in a plot to eventually restore the Republic's honor. However, the seal they stole was in reality a fake as well; the real seal having been lost to time many years before.<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
